entries.en: Oh, I fought {orcs}, {cyclopses}, {minotaurs}, even {dragons}, and many other creatures.
entries.translated: Oh, luché contra {orcs}, {cyclopses}, {minotaurs}, incluso {dragons} y muchas otras criaturas.

entries.en: Did you get the requested pickaxe from Uzgod in Kazordoon?
entries.translated: ¿Recibiste el pico solicitado por Uzgod en Kazordoon?

entries.en: Salutations, |PLAYERNAME| I guess you are here for the {horses}.
entries.translated: Saludos, |PLAYERNAME| Supongo que estás aquí por el {horses}.

entries.en: There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
entries.translated: Hay cinco bendiciones disponibles en cinco lugares sagrados: el escudo {spiritual}, la chispa del {phoenix}, el {embrace} de Tibia, el fuego del {suns} y la sabiduría de {solitude}. Además, puedes recibir el {twist of fate} aquí.

entries.en: No no no, I need 15 doses of freshly harvested pollen! Please, harvest those 15 doses yourself, to make absolutely sure you have first-rate quality. I am afraid nothing less will do.
entries.translated: No no no, necesito 15 dosis de polen recién cosechado! Por favor, coseche esas 15 dosis usted mismo para asegurarse de tener una calidad de primer nivel. Me temo que nada menos servirá.

entries.en: As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
entries.translated: Como aventurero, siempre debes tener al menos un {backpack}, un {rope}, un {shovel}, un {weapon}, un {armor} y un {shield}.

entries.en: The book! You have it! Let me see! <browses the book> ...
The most important tools you need are a {rope}, a {shovel} and maybe a {torch}.
entries.translated: Las herramientas más importantes que necesita son un {rope}, un {shovel} y tal vez un {torch}.

entries.en: The missions available for your rank are the {butterfly hunt}, {plant collection} and {ice delivery}.
entries.translated: Las misiones disponibles para tu rango son {butterfly hunt}, {plant collection} y {ice delivery}.

entries.en: The missions available for your rank are {lizard urn}, {bonelord secrets} and {orc powder}.
entries.translated: Las misiones disponibles para tu rango son {lizard urn}, {bonelord secrets} y {orc powder}.

entries.en: The missions available for your rank are {elven poetry}, {memory stone} and {rune writings}.
entries.translated: Las misiones disponibles para tu rango son {elven poetry}, {memory stone} y {rune writings}.
